newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Ecopetrol to drill 54 wells this year.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Ecopetrol to drill 54 wells this year.

text.p: Colombia's state oil company Ecopetrol said in a weekly report Monday that it plans to drill at least 54 wells this year.

The new wells, to be drilled jointly by Ecopetrol and foreign firms working in association with the state oil giant, will include 20 exploratory rigs, four of them dedicated to the search for methane gas, the report said.
According to Ecopetrol, British Petroleum Co Plc, Amoco Corp and Dallas-based Harken Energy Corp are the three largest exploratory holders in Colombia.
It said most of the wells would be drilled in the eastern plains and in the central Magdalena Valley region.
